Counsel for Respondent :- A.S.G.I.,Sarvesh Kumar Dubey Hon'ble Mrs. Sangeeta Chandra,J.
Hon'ble Brij Raj Singh,J.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner, learned Standing Counsel appearing on behalf of the State Respondents, Sri Sarvesh Kumar Dubey, learned counsel for the respondent- National Highway Authority of India and Sri Krishna Lal Yadav, Advocate, who has filed memo of appearance on behalf of the respondent no.1.

This petition has been filed with the following main prayer:-
"Issue a writ in the nature of mandamus thereby commanding and directing the opposite parties to disburse the compensation to the petitioner, as per structure valuation of the house of the petitioner prepared by the competent authority Rajesh Kumar vs Union Of India Thru. Secy. Govt. India ... on 1 October, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/55079518/
1 following the ingredient provided in Section3G(7) of the National Highways Act,
1956."

entities.text: Rajesh Kumar vs Union Of India Thru. Secy. Govt. India
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It is the case of the petitioner that structural evaluation over Gata No.607 Min. has already been completed.

Learned Standing Counsel has produced before this Court instructions dated 21.09.2024 sent by the Competent Authority (Land Acquisition), wherein it has been stated that Award was made after determination of compensation of Rs.20,09,932/- for acquisition of 0.613 hectare of Gata No.607 Min.
However, there is a dispute regarding apportionment of compensation between several claimants.
This petition is disposed of with a direction to the petitioner to move an appropriate application under Section 3H of the National Highways Act, 1956.
